title: FairLoop
summary: FairLoop is an open-source, agent-based bias prevention system that inserts a Neutral Validator Agent into the AI model training loop to catch and remediate biased data batches before training. Its Synth Agent optionally imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and conditional sampling to generate balanced synthetic samples for underrepresented groups, running SDV as one of several remediation strategies.
evidence: agents/synth_agent.py:35-125 imports CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, Condition and calls sample_from_conditions/sample
